text_en: You who live in the shelter of the Most High, who abide in the shadow of the Almighty,
text_cn: 你这在至高者护佑下居住的人， 你这在全能者荫庇下居住的人，

text_en: will say to the Lord , “My refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust. ”
text_cn: 请向上主说：“我的避难所，我的碉堡， 我的天主，我向你投靠。”

text_en: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler and from the deadly pestilence;
text_cn: 他必救你脱离猎户的缧绁（léi xiè）， 他必救你脱免害人的瘟疫。

text_en: he will cover you with his pinions, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness is a shield and buckler.
text_cn: 他以自己的羽毛掩护你， 又叫你往他的翼下逃避： 他的忠信是盾牌和铠衣。

text_en: You will not fear the terror of the night, or the arrow that flies by day,
text_cn: 你不必怕黑夜惊人的颤栗， 也不必怕白天乱飞的箭矢，

text_en: or the pestilence that stalks in darkness, or the destruction that wastes at noonday.
text_cn: 黑暗中流行的瘟疫， 正午毒害人的疠疾。

text_en: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
text_cn: 在你身旁虽倒毙一千， 在你右边虽跌仆一万， 疫疾却到不了你身边。

text_en: You will only look with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.
text_cn: 然而你亲眼要观临， 要见到恶人的报应。

text_en: Because you have made the Lord your refuge, the Most High your dwelling place,
text_cn: 你既知道上主是你的避难所， 你就该以至高者为你的碉堡；

text_en: no evil shall befall you, no scourge come near your tent.
text_cn: 灾殃不会走近你的身边， 祸患也不临近你的帐幔。

text_en: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
text_cn: 因为他必为你委派自己的天使， 在你行走的每条道路上保护你。

text_en: On their hands they will bear you up, so that you will not dash your foot against a stone.
text_cn: 他们把你托在自己的手掌， 不使你的脚在石头上碰伤。

text_en: You will tread on the lion and the adder, the young lion and the serpent you will trample under foot.
text_cn: 你可经过在狮子和毒蛇身上， 你可践踏在猛狮和毒龙身上。

text_en: Those who love me, I will deliver; I will protect those who know my name.
text_cn: 上主说：“因为他依恋我，我必拯救他， 他承认我的名，我必保护他。

text_en: When they call to me, I will answer them; I will be with them in trouble, I will rescue them and honor them.
text_cn: 他若呼求我，我必应允他， 他若有困苦，我必偕同他， 我必拯救他，也必光荣他。

text_en: With long life I will satisfy them, and show them my salvation.
text_cn: 我必要使他得享长寿， 必让他看到我的救赎。”
